## Activity

During February 2020, West Gate Eye Clinic recorded 309 captures. This provides the activity level for the reporting period and indicates the volume of images submitted for review. The recorded activity is presented for the site and month specified, with no additional activity measure included in this report.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for review. There were 6 ungradable images, representing an ungradable rate of 1.9. These results identify the images that could not be graded and provide the corresponding rate for the reporting period. No new equipment faults were raised during February 2020.

## Grading

Grading identified 58 referable results. The median lag between image capture and grading was 1 day. This records the typical time taken for grading across the reporting period and places the referable results in the context of the site’s review activity. Together, the grading results and the median lag provide a summary of the review process at West Gate Eye Clinic during February 2020.
